spine_edits.prompt: Edit this photographic book-spine cutout. Keep the title CHERRY and its restrained condensed red type, off-white paper color, small red publisher square, thin red foot strip, real photographic light, clean transparent background and straight spine-facing orientation. Remove the number 01 completely. Replace that number area with a tiny discreet printed tagline 'Start small.' rotated in the same reading direction as the title. Make this clearly a SLIM smooth matte printed PAPERBACK with crisp square cover corners and a little flexible cover edge. Avoid bulky hardback casing, leather grain, cloth, woven texture, overdistress. Height about 10 times width. Complete physical book spine visible; no backdrop, shelf or external shadow. Minimal Colophon/Monotype typography and negative space.

Rebuild this as a distinctly THICKER real leather-bound prayer-book spine cutout, while preserving exact title Held in elegant serif and the straight spine-facing photographic viewpoint. Rich dark muted plum fine-grain leather, subtle restrained warm gold foil title Held placed in upper-middle, only one very thin gold rule near the head and one near the foot, no number 02, no other numbers, no tagline, no symbols. Shallow real raised binding bands are allowed, very understated. Crisp square cover corners; never a rounded pill. Height about 6.5 times width so notably thicker than the input. Tiny view of actual cover board return on right. Soft natural upper-left studio light, photoreal material irregularity, transparent background, entire object visible. Restrained classic bookbinding, not fantasy ornamental leather.

Edit into a distinct very SLIM real contemporary paperback SPINE cutout. Preserve exact title FAP COUNT and restrained condensed black sans serif, orange printed paper jacket with short cream head band. Remove number 03 entirely. Add only a tiny quiet tagline 'Day by day.' near the foot rotated in the same reading direction as the title. Smooth matte coated paper, subtle true fold edges, crisp square corners, no leather, no textile weave. Height about 12 times width, thinner than all the other books. Title nearer upper third, ample blank orange below. Camera faces spine at bookshelf eye level, little right-hand paper return, realistic soft studio light, fully transparent background, no external shadow or other objects. No icons or decoration.

Edit into a BROADER real paper-over-board hardback record book spine cutout. Keep deep muted forest green, exact title CareLedger, straight spine-facing photographic view, natural light and fully transparent background. Make height about 5.5 times width, visibly thicker and broader than the input. The spine is smooth paper-wrapped hard board, NOT leather, NOT cloth. Put title CareLedger in restrained dark-green humanist sans serif on one warm ivory rectangular paper label occupying the central half of the spine, with title as one normal line rotated down the spine. Remove 04 and the old foot rectangle entirely; leave the green foot quiet and unmarked. No tagline, numbers, checks, ledger grid, icons, distress or illustration. Thin board return, squared cover corners, believable head and tail joints and binding. Entire physical book visible, no backdrop or shelf.

open_spread.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Website production asset: one photorealistic OPEN BOOK isolated on transparent background. This is a photograph of the physical object, not a paper texture and not a website mockup. A real contemporary hardback book opened flat to an empty cream spread. View straight-on perpendicular to the open page plane, almost orthographic, as if held open for the viewer. Rectangular portrait pages, approximately 2:3 width:height each, making overall spread about 4:3 landscape. Entire object inside frame with small transparent margin. Crisp square board and page corners, no rounded corners. Smooth warm ivory uncoated real printing paper, very fine understated grain. Believable shallow paper curvature into central gutter, delicate soft gutter shadow, subtle light from upper left, thin staggered page blocks visible at bottom and outer edges, actual glued or sewn binding, very thin neutral taupe paper-wrapped cover boards showing beyond pages. No cloth and no textile weave. Pages completely BLANK with no lettering, no illustrations, no printed borders, no collage, no stains, no damage, no decorations. Restrained beautiful editorial product photography. Background fully transparent, no floor, no stand, no hands, no external cast shadow. Preserve natural tiny physical paper irregularities. The object itself must look convincingly photographic and tangible, not a flat beige rectangle.
